trigger_condition: JSON quoting or escapes conceal credential markers and machine-local paths
guard_snippet: Parse JSON; normalize decoded strings and scan decoded property/value pairs before serialization.
potential_consequence: Sensitive JSON passes publication scanning and remains eligible for upload.

guard_snippet: Normalize decoded JSON strings instead of applying path regexes to serialized JSON.
potential_consequence: Normalization consumes closing JSON syntax and publishes a malformed report.

trigger_condition: Aggregate preparation runs after the validator records OutputSha256
guard_snippet: Write only changed content using WriteAllText without appending a newline.
potential_consequence: Published report bytes no longer match their recorded audit digest.

trigger_condition: Worker normalization changes report content before aggregate auditing
guard_snippet: Capture original and published digests before first normalization; verify their binding during aggregation.
potential_consequence: Aggregate input and source hashes describe normalized content; original hashes become unrecoverable.

trigger_condition: Actual unsafe content makes either publication guard render upload ineligible
guard_snippet: The raw-text scan accepts {"source":"pass\u0077ord=synthetic"}, whose decoded value contains password=synthetic.
potential_consequence: Credential-bearing JSON uploads despite a successful publication policy step.
